# BracketView

> BracketView is a freemium online JSON viewer, formatter, validator, and query workspace for developers. Core tools run 100% client-side in the browser — no install required. Built by Jameel Shaikh.

BracketView lets developers format, validate, query, diff, and share JSON in a full-screen, distraction-free workspace. Freemium pricing: core tools are free forever; Pro ($6/month or $54/year) unlocks unlimited AI, 50 MB uploads, and unlimited encrypted snapshot links.

Key capabilities include tree and graph views, JSONPath and JQ filter playground (WebAssembly), AI JSON repair, JSON diff, schema validation, type generation in 9+ languages, and encrypted shareable snapshots.

## App & site

- [BracketView web app](https://app.bracketview.in): Open the JSON workspace — paste, format, validate, and query JSON
- [BracketView marketing site](https://bracketview.in): Product overview, pricing, features, and documentation

## Tool pages

- [JSON Formatter](https://bracketview.in/json-formatter): Beautify and minify JSON online
- [JSON Validator](https://bracketview.in/json-validator): Real-time syntax validation with inline errors
- [JSON Diff](https://bracketview.in/json-diff): Side-by-side comparison of two JSON documents
- [JSONPath Query](https://bracketview.in/jsonpath-query): Query JSON with JSONPath expressions
- [JQ Playground](https://bracketview.in/jq-playground): Full jq filter engine in the browser via WebAssembly
- [JSON Schema Validator](https://bracketview.in/json-schema-validator): Validate JSON against JSON Schema
- [JSON Type Generator](https://bracketview.in/json-type-generator): Export TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, and more from JSON
